title: One rulebook: map the A-O standards onto Peer AI's rule ids, and clear the v0 leftovers from docs
goal: The project carries 62 rules of its own, A1 to O4, beside Peer AI's, with no single place saying which covers which. That overlap already cost a week: TS-08 and REACT-03 are one ESLint rule under two ids, and nobody saw the 400-line limit had stopped applying. Two documents are also v0 residue - the kick-off pack, superseded by CLAUDE.md and still describing a v3 server and paid tiers, and 07-frontend-coding-rules, 28 lines pointing at 05 - and six documents name paths that no longer exist.
acceptance: Given the 62 rules A1 to O4, when the map is written, then every one has a row naming the Peer AI rule or rules that cover it, or saying in words that none does, with no rule left out
Given the map, when it is read the other way, then the Peer AI rules that have no project equivalent are listed too, so a reader can see what Peer AI adds rather than only what it duplicates

Given docs/Mizaniya_Kickoff_Pack.md and docs/07-frontend-coding-rules.md, when they are deleted, then nothing in the repository links to either, and what each carried that is still true lives somewhere current

Given the six documents the project map flags for naming src/ui, src/core, src/design/tokens.ts or peer-ai/shared/design-data-contract.md, when they are fixed, then project_map flags no file for naming a path that does not exist
Given CLAUDE.md section 2 states which rulebook wins, when this lands, then it points at the map rather than restating the rules, and the precedence is written in exactly one place

reviews.summary: Pass, all five criteria, each checked by running something. All 62 project rules are mapped, proven by differencing the two sets of ids rather than by reading. peer-ai assess now names no stale document where it named six, which took three passes because it reports one per file per run. The kick-off pack's deletion had a recorded decision against it, so the stakeholder's one unique sentence was moved before the file went.
